title: German: 120 Essential Verbs

sources.name: Original educational wording based on general subject knowledge

description: For beginning German learners: common infinitives with English meanings, present-tense ich, du, and er forms, usage examples, and separable prefixes.

cards.back: sein (Latin-script infinitive): to be. Present: ich bin; du bist; er ist.
